title: Doesn't work well
text: Doesn't work well. For those who missed it in other reviews, you have to wind the knob fully clockwise and then counterclockwise to the time you require. NP there. Thing is, it doesn't keep correct time and unless you're nearby, you can barely hear it when it sounds off. My suggestion is you look for another timer.

product_metadata.title: Norpro New 60 Minute Kitchen Timer With Long Ring 3.5"/9cm Easy To Read Operate
features: Item Measures: 3.75" x 4.25" x 2" / 9.5cm x 11cm x 5cm

Operating Instructions: Turn the timer dial all the way around to the 60-minute mark, then backward to the time you want to set it for. Failure to follow these instructions will result in the timer not working properly. The ringer rings for approximately 4 seconds.
